title: Cisco Secure Client Per-App VPN for Managed Mobile Devices (iOS/Android) via Intune
hook: Tunnel only the apps that need it — on managed iPhones and Androids
problem: A device-wide mobile VPN backhauls personal traffic, drains battery, and worries users. Per-app VPN tunnels only the managed business apps that need internal resources and leaves everything else direct. This solution builds Cisco Secure Client per-app VPN for iOS and Android through Microsoft Intune — associating specific managed apps to the VPN profile so the tunnel opens only for them, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how per-app VPN works on iOS and Android, the managed-app-to-VPN association, on-demand behavior, and where Intune's per-app VPN configuration meets the Cisco head-end.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune enrollment + managed apps, the Secure Client app + VPN profile, certificate or auth method, Entra ID groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to build the per-app VPN profile for iOS and Android, associate the named managed apps, assign to a pilot group, validate only those apps tunnel, then expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — per-app VPN readiness discovery, per-device app/VPN association validation, a per-app VPN coverage report, safe remediation of mis-scoped apps, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (managed app tunnels, other traffic direct), plus Best Practices for the managed-app model.
short: Build Cisco Secure Client per-app VPN for iOS and Android through Intune so only named managed apps tunnel to internal resources — not the whole device — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
